o.text: From yaxa (“collar”) + -la. Literally, “to grab by the collar”.

From the earlier prevalent but now chiefly dialectal yayxalamaq, from yayxa- + -ala, for which compare Ottoman Turkish یایقامق (yayqamaq) and modern Turkish yıkamak. Ultimately from Proto-Common Turkic *yāy- (“to shake”), and its older form *yāń-.
Related to yayxanmaq.
